title: Agent health and recovery
summary: The hypervisor MUST use agent evidence, prevent duplicates, and stop repeated recovery failures.
instructions: The hypervisor MUST run one non-overlapping tick every 15 minutes.
Health decisions MUST use transcript, process, terminal, executor, and expected-invocation evidence.
Time since a harness action MUST NOT prove agent health.
Unknown health MUST NOT start recovery or another agent.
A quiet agent MUST have two unchanged scans before a stalled verdict.
Recovery MUST try nudge, resume, validated re-delivery, and conditional re-prepare in that order.
The second matching recovery failure MUST quarantine the agent and stop autonomous retries.
The registry MUST preserve agent identity, parentage, run context, evidence, health, and recovery state.
